title: Correct system acceleration
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (1) must be 3.75 m/s² (or equivalent).

title: Correct tension F_AB
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (2) must be 18.75 N (or equivalent).

title: Correct tension F_AC
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (3) must be 6.25 N (or equivalent).

title: Net force equation setup
description: Important: The student must apply Newton's second law to the entire system, correctly identifying all forces (gravity on B, friction on A and C).

title: Free-body diagram reasoning
description: Important: The solution should show separate free-body analyses for object B and object C (or A) to derive the tension equations.

title: Friction force calculation
description: Important: The friction forces on blocks A and C must be correctly calculated as μ * m_A * g and μ * m_C * g, opposing motion.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All intermediate calculations and final answers should include correct SI units (m/s², N).

title: Sign error in tensions
description: Pitfall: Deduct if the student incorrectly assigns the direction of tension forces (e.g., reversing F_AB or F_AC in equations).

title: Incorrect friction application
description: Pitfall: Deduct if friction is omitted, applied only to one block, or applied to block B (which is hanging).
